location_in_official_text: Rule 6 Free Kicks, Section 1, Article 6 Onside Kick
verbatim_text: At any time during the game, the kicking team may declare an onside kick by notifying the Referee prior to the start of the play clock (25-second play clock after the game official hands the kicker the ball). The Referee will then notify the receiving team before starting the play clock and the following rules will apply:

(a) An onside kick is defined as a free kick that the kicking team attempts to legally recover from the kicking team's restraining line to the furthest point downfield within the onside kick setup zone.

(b) The restraining line for the kicking team on an onside kick is the kicking team's 35-yard line or the kicking team's 20-yard line for a safety kick unless either line is adjusted because of a distance penalty.
